title: Conditional kappa = 0.001591975256487475: five-copy remainder pooling and exact carrier epochs
body:
This adds research/pooled-clone-epochs, with conditional

**kappa = 0.001591975256487475 = 63679010259499 / 40000000000000000.**

This is a small, exact increase of **0.000399106673%** over the equal kappa reported in #551 and #552, at the public snapshot frozen through #555. The numerical gain comes from a new finite five-copy whole-owner pooling construction. A separate exact carrier-basis rewrite removes 28 local scalar instructions; its paid rank profile is unchanged.

The certified complex saving is b = 0.001594513682816650764990. The cited #555 bit saving is c = 0.001733052823330162099157, pinned at 65a6bc19f820c8b1873f65a517bcf70cd6887223. Complex remains binding. Both endpoints are composed through the complete profiles, fresh finite invoice and all 47 strict outer inequalities; gains are not added to earlier kappa values.

### Numerical mechanism: turn a fractional remainder pattern into a finite controller

The previous complex allocation leaves one rank-48 pending child containing one width-9 residual, hence a paid rank-39 remainder. A capacity relaxation suggested concentrating five such residuals together. The construction makes five copies of the finite source controller and interleaves the five corresponding complete calls at each original call time. Each local call still has ambient dimension 73; the local supplier is not enlarged.

Exactly five width-9 helper occurrences are redirected into disjoint offsets 0,9,18,27,36 of one rank-48 pending family. Each helper stays whole in one family. The selected owner is idle through all five calls, is never an active data family there, and spectators are restored at each complete-call boundary. Four former owners become entirely unused pending children. The resulting exact change relative to five copies of the old complete profile is

    -5 children of rank 39 +4 children of rank 48 +1 child of rank 3.

Total rank mass is unchanged. For every 0 < a < 1, strict concavity gives

    4*48^a +3^a < 5*39^a, since 39 = (4*48+3)/5.

This proves a strictly better recurrence moment, but the numerical bound additionally pays the enlarged finite controller and prefix. Live stock is 35,840, physical stock is 36,354 and deficit is 12,800. The literal witness contains 181,440 whole helper roles over 360 complete calls. Measured prefix 801 is charged at 1,024; physical row coefficient 17,495 is below the retained allowance 20,161.

The complete complex histogram is

    {1:828000, 2:160640, 3:179536, 4:66240, 5:20160,
     6:20160, 7:1040, 8:2880, 48:8304}.

### Scalar mechanism: a paid, reversible carrier epoch

Within the source-pinned A epoch, helpers 571 and 585 are read but never written. Both have the common boundary frame [480]. Introduce r' = r+s, rewrite every read t += q*r as t += q*r' - q*s, combine only commuting equal-frame shears, and undo the basis change at the end. Both boundary operations are explicit and charged.

The exact map on all input coordinates is unchanged. A decreases from 2,007 to 1,993 gates, and inverse background cleanup from 2,847 to 2,833: 28 fewer scalar instructions per invocation. Emitted events decrease from 21,483 to 21,455 in each orientation. This is a circuit simplification, not an additional paid-moment saving.

### Verification

The changed complex supplier passes fresh transport, phase, adapter, emitted-local and arbitrary-dirt checks. All 728 formal columns are checked in both orientations, with all 504 dirty helpers restored. Phase admission covers 2,929 directed edges and 224 endpoints, using explicitly hash-bound cache reuse where appropriate. An independent multiprecision-dyadic C++ audit also compares all 529,984 coefficients of the entire main transfer matrix. Its terminal-inverse and transformed-reader omission controls change 4 and 8 target coefficients respectively.

The new controller is independently checked against its actual source-bound 73-column charts, complete idle intervals, active-data exclusions, residual widths, disjoint pending coordinates and every paid remainder. Seven owner corruption controls are rejected. A fresh scalar/prefix invoice, two rational moment engines with next-grid rejection, six bootstrap steps, all 47 outer inequalities and four assembly controls pass. The unchanged #555 physical bit operator is cited and numerically repriced, rather than redundantly rebuilt here. Remote GitHub CI status is separate from these local receipts.

Replay, with a new work directory outside the package:

    python -B research/pooled-clone-epochs/verify.py --work ../fresh-pooled-clone-run

Keep assertions enabled. Source and generated-word pins use canonical content where compression or line-ending differences would otherwise be incidental.

### Direct lineage and evaluated related work

- #552 supplies the selected collective-wave complex baseline and its twelve weighted response substitutions. Its earlier 624-addition saving is inherited, not counted again.
- #551 independently reaches the same prior kappa with its subspace16 complex construction and full R420 replay. It is the concurrent comparison baseline, not an extra numerical ingredient.
- #555 supplies the selected stronger bit endpoint, combining #545's punctured unit with #543's R420 skeleton; its selected bit word has 439 helpers and 111 live ports.
- #554 motivated explicit transplantation and componentwise tests of the alternate joint retiming. Those alternatives did not improve the selected wavefront word, so their reported gains are not added here.
- #553 supplies relevant formal sorted-width matching and offset-compaction results. Its documented source-association and physical-semantics limits remain; it does not formally certify this new five-copy controller.
- #531 supplies the 504-helper direct-delivery ancestry; #535 the post-centre rank-four construction; #534 the retiming/owner lineage; #541 the static44 local construction; #544 its full physical admission; #548 the strengthened complex baseline; and #547 the earlier bit/complex composition. These are inherited construction and validation dependencies, not independent gains being summed.

Existing upstream notices, licenses and assistance disclosures remain with the vendored sources.

### Retained research and scope

The research notes preserve the sufficient epoch identity, the whole-owner cloning/pooling proof and unsuccessful finite searches: cumulative rank-four retirement and mixed providers; PR554 direct/meet/join frame components; paid two-delivery windows; coherent read-only epochs; generalized producer/reader gauges with exact suffix-observability guards; and bounded frame reoptimization. The epoch lane screened 128 paired windows, 1,052 maximal epochs and 22,394 generalized windows. The fixed-capacity optimization nominated the denominator-five pattern; no floating solver result is presented as an exact global optimality theorem.

A useful next direction is to lift other small-denominator resource patterns into explicit complete-call schedules, or change the local residual inventory before repeating the allocation search. Each proposal still needs actual owner chronology, all dirty/phase checks and the full finite invoice.

The result remains conditional on inherited all-size compiler realization, common-label/mutable-source transfer, whole-call hosting, precision/tape and analytic-transfer premises, including the bit supplier's stated interfaces. It is not an unconditional integer-multiplication theorem, a complete Lean formalization, a measured practical speedup, or a claim of a large breakthrough.
